// The wipe target is a plain string constant, not a loop variable and not an
// inline literal. Both the original text scan and the first AST version were
// blind to this shape — it is how `livekit-cohort.test.js` wipes.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');
const { clearCollection } = require('../helpers/firebase-emulator');

const SEG_EVENTS = 'segregationEvents';

beforeEach(async () => {
  await clearCollection(db, SEG_EVENTS);
});
